title: Building Legal Agents When You Can't See the Data - Jacob Lauritzen, CTO of Legora
author: Latent.Space
description: Legora can’t read a single trace of what its agent does for a lawyer. The data belongs to the law firm’s clients. How do you build and test an agent when you can’t see its work? Jacob Lauritzen is the CTO of Legora, one of the fastest-growing companies...
summary: Legora can’t read a single trace of what its agent does for a lawyer. The data belongs to the law firm’s clients.
takeaways: The team started in a Stockholm basement with ChatGPT, Swedish law, and a search tool.
